get.description: Open searches, plus closed ones whose candidates are still available, newest first.

post.description: Interview a candidate; the response says what it taught (M4c).
Check a candidate's references; the response says what it taught (M4c).
The offer dialog's hint and rule checks. No energy, no randomness, nothing saved.

get.description:
Newest first. `limit` and `offset` page through a long inbox (M2b); repeat `kind` to
keep only those message kinds, across every page (M3b).

post.description: Move a team under a department or the company root (formulas.md 13.1).
Energy and one-off morale changes, by person, before a reorganization (13.7).

get.description: Plans that are not closed, by id, with what each delegate did last.
Categories and their segments, with today's addressable demand.

Every product selling in the category: owner, public scores, appeal, customers and
share of served customers, per segment.

The Products screen's tiles: MRR and its change, ARR, customers, hosting and
marketing this month.
The player's products that are not retired, by id.

post.description: Appeal and share* at a price against the current competitors. Nothing is saved.
Put a unit (or, with a null unit, the company root) on the product.
Refused with `launch_not_ready`, naming what is missing, below the thresholds.
Cancel a product in development: it retires at once and its units are freed.

The founder scouts every open candidate of the search (20 energy, formulas.md 11.12);
the response says what it taught about each (M4c).

get.description: P&L, balance sheet and cash flow for every closed month, quarter or year (14.1).

Cash, the projected net burn and runway ("profitable" when null), insolvency and the
game state (ADR-0018).
Holders, classes, shares and percentages; every grant with vested and unvested.
Seats, each director's confidence and trend, and the last quarterly meeting (14.6).

How the game ended: the reason, the turn, the last numbers and the last six months'
finance news (ADR-0018). Works on an active save too (game_state "active").
Every SAFE and bridge; an open bridge offer shows today's amount (14.7).

post.description: Investors answer at the next Continue, all or nothing (14.4).
The hint band (likely, uncertain, unlikely) and the rule checks. Nothing is saved.
The bridge's money arrives at this month's Continue (14.7).

get.description: Every round with its term sheets, and whether the next series is allowed (14.5).

post.description: Term sheets arrive at the next Continue.

get.description:
Every holder before and after accepting: the pool top-up, SAFE conversion and the
new preferred, computed with the closing function. Nothing is saved.

post.description: The round closes at the next Continue; the other term sheets lapse.

get.description: Everything the new-game setup screen needs (M1c).
Channel costs, energy and offer limits for the Recruitment screen (M1c).
Energy costs, unlock rule and options for the org screens (formulas.md 6, 13).

post.description: Skill values, points left and every rule broken. Never current ability.

get.description: Energy costs and launch thresholds for the product screens (formulas.md 6, 11.2).
